title: Some performance schema tables return invalid rows

comments.text:
Hello Manuel Ung,

Thank you for the report and feedback.

regards,
Umesh

Posted by developer:
 
Added the following note to the MySQL Server 8.3.0 release notes:

Under certain circumstances, under load, the Performance Schema could return the same row twice, despite having a unique key defined.
This issue could occur for query digests, user names, host names, and account names (user@host).

This is flagged as fixed in 8.3.0, but as affecting 8.0.32.

Will this be fixed in a future 8.0 release.
